# Spring-NWVMC (`0.1.0` — Official Maven Central)

> Enterprise declarative REST, GraphQL, persistence, RBAC/ABAC security, resilience, and observability starter (*Next-Wave Virtual Multi-Controller*) for **Java 21 LTS** and **Spring Boot 3.x** (`io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` on Maven Central; GitHub Pages Docs: https://natswarchuan.github.io/Spring-NWVMC-document/). Declare a JPA `@Entity` extending `BaseAuditEntity` in `entity/` and an `@AutoRestController` interface extending `AutoApiController<E>` (or narrow composable interfaces `AutoReadApi<E>`..`AutoAiApi<E>`) in `controller/` to expose 40 standardized REST/streaming/schema/AI endpoints (`38` visible by default in Swagger UI) with optional `@ServiceOverride` escape hatches and MVC code ejection.

## Critical Anti-Hallucination & SDD/TDD Facts (Read First)

- **Mandatory SDD + TDD Gate:** Draft `specs/<feature>/spec.md` (`REQ-ID` Given/When/Then criteria), stop on any `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`, build `plan.md` (Traceability Matrix) & `tasks.md`, and execute **RED (failing JUnit 5 / `MockMvc` test) → GREEN (minimal declarative code) → REFACTOR** across 4 test tiers with zero `@Disabled` tests. *(Small tweaks/prototypes: lightweight mini-spec + 1 `MockMvc`/regression test.)*
- **Artifact (Maven Central):** `io.github.natswarchuan:spring-nwvmc:0.1.0` (no `v` prefix, no custom repository needed; optional JitPack mirror: `com.github.NatswarChuan:Spring-NWVMC:v0.1.0` with `v` prefix); requires Java 21 + `<parameters>true</parameters>` in `maven-compiler-plugin`.
- **6 Exact Annotation Packages (60 annotations, 133 attributes):** `io.github.natswarchuan.core.annotation.*` (54), `io.github.natswarchuan.module.cache.http.annotation.HttpCacheable`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.datasource.annotation.{TargetDataSource, TargetDatabasePlatform}`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.event.annotation.PublishCloudEvent`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.lock.annotation.DistributedLock`, `io.github.natswarchuan.module.webhook.annotation.EntityWebhook`.
- **9 Real Composable Controller Interfaces (40 total):** `AutoReadApi` (5), `AutoKeysetApi` (1), `AutoAnalyticsApi` (4), `AutoSchemaApi` (5), `AutoWriteApi` (6), `AutoBatchApi` (4), `AutoExportImportApi` (4), `AutoWorkflowApi` (9), `AutoAiApi` (2). NEVER invent `AutoAuditApi` or `AutoStateApi`.
- **Never use `@Data` on JPA `@Entity`** and **never invent `@SoftDelete`** (UUIDv7 `id`, soft-delete, audit columns, `@Version` optimistic locking are inherited from `BaseAuditEntity`).
- **`@StateMachine.transitions`** uses **colon syntax** (`"CREATED:PENDING_PAYMENT,CANCELLED"`), never `"FROM -> TO"`. Trigger transitions with query param `POST /api/v1/{entity}/{id}/transition?targetState=PENDING_PAYMENT` (illegal jumps & non-deletable deletes return HTTP **`422 Unprocessable Entity`**).
- **Query filter operators** use **dot syntax** (`FilterOperatorConstant`: `.eq`, `.ne`, `.like`, `.startsWith`, `.endsWith`, `.gt`, `.gte`, `.lt`, `.lte`, `.in`, `.notIn`, `.between`, `.null`), never `__gte`, `.neq`, `.ilike`, `.isNull`, or `.isNotNull`.
- **CamelCase routes & `basePath`:** `ECommerceOrder` maps to `/api/v1/e-commerce-orders`; always use `@AutoRestController(basePath = "...")` (proxy registrar ignores `path`).
- **Bean ordering, AOP & `@Idempotent`:** Inject framework `@AutoComponent` helpers via `ObjectProvider<T>` (`.getObject()` at call time). Mark AOP-intercepted consumer `@Service` beans (`@DistributedLock`, `@AutoCacheable`, `@AutoCacheEvict`, `@TargetDataSource`) as **non-final** + **`@Lazy`**, AND inject them via `ObjectProvider<MyService>` or `@Lazy` in consumer callers (`0.1.0` supports method-level and class-level `@TargetDataSource` natively). NEVER place `@Transactional` on `public final class` Helpers. Use `HttpHeaderConstant.HEADER_X_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY` (or `AopConstant.HEADER_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`) for `"X-Idempotency-Key"`.
- **Dev JWT & Testing:** Dev token endpoint is `POST /api/v1/auth/token?username=admin&role=ROLE_ADMIN` (`200 OK`, `data.token`); `JwtTokenService.generateToken(username, userId, roles)` takes `username` FIRST.
- **Production lockdown:** Keep `app.framework.studio.enabled: false`, `demo-token-endpoint-enabled: false`, `default-deny-unannotated-entities: true`, `require-authenticated-api-paths: true`, `fail-fast-weak-jwt-secret: true`, `JWT_SECRET >= 32` UTF-8 bytes (HS256) / `>= 64` bytes (HS512), Springdoc disabled, CORS restricted, and `ddl-auto: validate` in `application.yml` / `application-prod.yml`. Verify JWT `tenantId` vs `X-Tenant-ID` via `SecurityIdentityCustomizer`.

- [AI-Agent Kit README](ai-agent-kit/README.md): English onboarding guide, agent compatibility matrix, hardened zero-clone 1-command installers (`install.ps1` / `install.sh`), and starter prompts.

- [RULES](ai-agent-kit/RULES.md): Mandatory SDD/TDD protocol, strict consumer rules, and empirically verified anti-hallucination & AppSec guardrails (`< 24 KB`).
- [SKILL](ai-agent-kit/SKILL.md): Progressive-disclosure `spring-nwvmc-adoption` runbook (**7 workflows** `0`–`6` + **15-row** root-cause troubleshooting matrix).
